jobInfo.jobDescription:
Substitute Food Service Workers sought for all schools--hours vary. 
Substitute hiring is ongoing throughout the year. Experience preferred, but not required.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT:
Salary per Collective Bargaining Agreement (LEA).
Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.
Information regarding CORI and SAFIS background checks can be obtained by contacting:
Nadine Lorenzen, Food Service Director or . Food Service Director 1025 Massachusetts Avenue, Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4100, Extension 5226
Liz Petersen, Administrative Secretary to the Superintendent of Schools
Office of the Superintendent 129 Northfield Road, Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4100, Extension 5211
